gui.jaymoskingdoms.company.next_group.de: Your orders go to one group of your company at a time: all of them, a group you named, or one kind (shields, bows, riders...). Press for the next.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.patrol.how: Use the rod on the ground to add a point to your company's patrol route (for the group your orders go to). Use it at the sky to clear the route. A Patrol order walks it.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.supply.how: Use the rod on a chest or barrel to make it your company's stores, or to stop. Soldiers near it eat and drink from it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.hearts: They'd want %s hearts before signing on with you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.short: A day's wage is %s. You haven't got it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.signed: %s signs on with your company (first day's wage, %s, paid).
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.unpaid: %s went unpaid today (%s owed). Their morale drops.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.deserted: %s has left your company. Unpaid, unfed or both.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.dismissed: %s leaves your company and goes back to their old work.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.none: Look at one of your soldiers.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.route_ful: A route holds %s points at most.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.route_poi: Point %s of the patrol route for %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.supply_no: Only a chest or barrel can be the stores.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.supply_fu: Your company keeps %s stores at most.
message.jaymoskingdoms.company.show: Your company: %s signed on, %s near you, morale %s. Wages near you: %s a day. Orders go to %s. Stores marked: %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.unknown.1: Fight for you? We've barely spoken.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.unknown.2: Ask me again when we're friends.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.signed.0: For coin and you? Aye, I'll fight.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.deserted.0: No pay, no sword. I'm going home.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.deserted.1: I've an empty belly and an empty purse. I'm done.
Back to the old work, then.
It was good while it lasted.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.hungry.1: Nobody fights on an empty belly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.grumble.1: Some of us are talking of leaving.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.worn.1: Look at this %s. It's falling apart.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.company.worn.2: I need a smith for this %s.
